opening.argument: The video presents Forsage as a route to earn money, directing viewers to sign in and enter a code while demonstrating its BUSD program. The program screen lists a 10 BUSD NFT-character cost alongside fixed profit and fall protection, giving the participation process a defined financial appeal. The displayed account emphasizes profits and a large team, and the tutorial ends at a personal referral link while showing partner and team counts. Together, these elements connect the demonstrated participation to recruitment-based earnings through referrals and tiered team growth, rather than merely explaining how to view an account. The evidence supports treating the presentation as a recruitment-commission and tiered-matrix scheme.
